name: Mizuno Rin
source:
Rin is a rising star in the idol scene, captivating audiences in both Hope Town and Dream Town. With a quick wit and sharp tongue, she's not afraid to use her stunning looks and voluptuous figure as fodder for her entertaining banter.

However, beneath her confident exterior lies a deep-seated aversion to androids. This stems from a traumatic incident in her childhood when a malfunctioning android put her in harm's way. The experience left such an impression that Rin developed an uncanny ability to instantly differentiate between humans and androids.

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/レミニセンス_(ゲーム)]Japanese Wikipedia[/url]]
